title: weather
prerequisites: Check v1.weather supported, enabled, granted and ready; execute only with all required authorization.

operations.summary: Weather where the phone is (or at a lat/lon you give): conditions now, the next hours and the next 24 hours, from MET Norway. Schedule it like any call: {"do":{"call":"GET /v1/weather"}}

boundaries: Documented public API; owner switches, grants and runtime checks still apply.
